newsitem.title: USA: Aetna shares open sharply higher.
newsitem.headline: Aetna shares open sharply higher.

text.p: Aetna Inc shares opened sharply higher on Tuesday after the insurance company reported higher than expected first-quarter earnings.
Shares jumped 2-7/8 to 93-1/2 at around 1015 EDT, shortly after the stock's delayed opening. Volume was 255,700 shares.
Aetna earlier on Tuesday announced earnings of $1.14 per share against a market consensus of $1.05, according to First Call analysts' estimates.
"Our efforts to reposition Aetna began to pay off in the first quarter of 1997," Aetna Chairman Ronald Compton said in a statement.
